title: CO2 forecast
description: Published by the forecast service to MQTT topic co2/<room_id>/forecast; consumed by the decision service.

room_id.description: Room identifier, matching BuildSim's room key.

ppm_forecast.description: Predicted CO2 concentration at ts + horizon_min.

horizon_min.description: Minutes ahead the forecast targets. Working figure is 30; not yet validated (see project_notes.md §7).
